headline: Nigerian Exchange Market Capitalization Declines by N27.98 Billion
summary: Equities on the Nigerian Exchange (NGX) closed lower on Thursday, with total market capitalization falling by N27.98 billion to settle at N161.21 trillion.
why: The NGX is the primary stock exchange in Nigeria; a contraction in market capitalization reflects broader investor sentiment and liquidity conditions in the Nigerian equity market.

impacts.name: NGX
impacts.why: The exchange's total market capitalization decreased.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: General market sell-offs and negative investor sentiment led to a contraction in the total value of listed equities.
